verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v1: yā kāshifa d-dāʾi wal-ʾaswā waʾaḍrāri mufīḍa ʾabḥuri ʾanwāri waʾasrāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v2: bil-khtiyāri kamā qad shāʾa jalla ʾilā ʾaḥibbahi kāna ʾakhyāri waʾaḥrāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v3: yā ʾakrama l-kuramā yā ʾarḥama r-ruḥamā yā ʾalṭafa lluṭafā yā barda ʾaḥrārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v4: man lā yukhayyibu ʿabdā jāʾa yasʾaluhu yā māniʿā ʿan saʾūli ṣaʿra ʾaḥrāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v5: yā llāhu yā rabbanā ghaffāra zallatinā yā hādiyā dhā ḍalāli ḥāʾirā sāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v6: ʾinnī ʾuṣibtu bidāʾi lā ṭabība lahu siwā lladhī kulla yawmi shaʾanuhu jāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v7: wad-dāʾu yā rabbi ʾaḍnānī waʾadnafanī ʿajjil ʾighāthatanā yā khāliqu l-bārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v8: ʾinnī waʾin kuntu ʾathwābī mudannasata bimāʾi ʿafwika ʾarjū ghasla ʾaqdhārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v9: waraḥmahu llāhi kulla l-khalqi qad wasiʿat min fājiri wamuṭīʿi zāhidi bārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v10: law kāna bābuka lā yaʾatīhi dhū ʾithami famā dduʿīta ghafūrā kulla ʾawzāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v11: khāṭabtu rabbī khiṭābā lā yalīqu binā fāghfir liʿabdi mina l-ʾāthāmi ḥayyāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v12: wafī kitābika rabbī "ʾinnamā ṣ-ṣadaqā tu" rabbi lil-fuqarā min dūni ʾinkāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v13: ʾinnī faqīru wamiskīnu wamunkasiru mā ḥtāja ghayraka fī taysīri ʾawṭārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v14: ʾanta waliyyiyā fī d-dunyā waḍarratihā tawaffanī muslimā fī rahṭi ʾabrāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v15: hab lī ʾilahiyā rabbī tawbata kamulat wāstur khaṭāyāyā rabbī ʾayyā ʾistāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v16: waṣ-ṣabra ʿan shahawāti n-nafsi thumma ʿalā maṣāʾibi rabbanā fī hadhihi d-dāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v17: waṣ-ṣabra fī niʿami lam ʾuḥṣi ʿiddatahā wash-shukru yā rabbi ʾaʿyānī kaʾiḥṣārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v18: walaysa birruka makhṣūṣā biman ḥasunat ḥālātuhu dhā mtināni qaṣda ʾibrārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v19: walā takilnī ʾilā ʾammāratī ʿiwajā wala shikāyata ʾasqāmī liʾaghyāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v20: ʾinnī ʾataytuka bil-ʾadnāsi multabisā walā yudannisu baḥra l-ʿafwi ʾakdārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v21: law lam takun raḥmahu r-raḥmāni qad sabaqat lamittu min haybati fī tīhi ʾakhṭārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v22: yā wayḥa nafsiyā law wayḥu yunaqqidhunī yawma ʾulāqī dhunūbā mithla ʾaḥjāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v23: ʾin qulta "yaʾayyuhā l-ʾinsānu" ʿātibanā famā ʾujībuka dhāka l-yawma yā ʿārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v24: fāstur hunāka kamā fī dhī maʿāyibanā yā llāhu yā rabbi zaḥziḥnī ʿani n-nāri
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v25: wawālidayyā waʾashyākhī washīʿatanā ʾaḥibbatī wadhawī l-ʾislāmi yā bārī
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v26: ʾazkā ṣalāti wataslīmi ʿalā qamari min nūrihi naylu mā nilnā mina nwār
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-ya-kashifa-dai-c1-v27: wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi ʾaqmāri l-ʿufāti waman sabīlahum salakū rabbī mina brāri
